GENERAL — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: General
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Digital Citizenship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Digital Citizenship to shame classmates.
   B. Copy a rumour about Digital Citizenship without checking.
   C. Apply Digital Citizenship with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Treat Digital Citizenship as empty slogans with no facts.

2. Which option best shows correct understanding of Impact of ICT on society? (1 mark)
   A. Apply Impact of ICT on society with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   B. Copy a rumour about Impact of ICT on society without checking.
   C. Treat Impact of ICT on society as empty slogans with no facts.
   D. Use Impact of ICT on society to shame classmates.

3. Which option best shows correct understanding of Spreadsheet? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Spreadsheet without checking.
   B. Apply Spreadsheet with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   C. Treat Spreadsheet as empty slogans with no facts.
   D. Use Spreadsheet to shame classmates.

4. Which option best shows correct understanding of Database Management System? (1 mark)
   A. Use Database Management System to shame classmates.
   B. Treat Database Management System as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Apply Database Management System with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Copy a rumour about Database Management System without checking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
5. In three clear sentences, explain Spreadsheet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. In three clear sentences, explain Database Management System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Impact of ICT on society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Spreadsheet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Database Management System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Impact of ICT on society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
